proof_scope: Live VS Code agent-human collaboration: drive the debugger-vscode-bridge on the multi-file variable_state module (entry main.py -> report.py -> bug in tally.py), run the real program to a breakpoint at the bug, read the paused frame, explain the defect from that state, then move to the next breakpoint. Capability-gated: a live run needs a VS Code window with the bridge active on a TRUSTED workspace, else the case is BLOCKED (never a false PASS).

claims.proves: when a live trusted VS Code bridge is present, the driver runs a real debug session to two breakpoints and reads the paused state that exposes the state-leak bug; and that the driver fails closed (BRIDGE_BLOCKED, exit 3) when no live bridge answers
claims.does_not_prove: single-session step/continue continuity across both stops, or human confirmation/correction altering the next action -- those need the session-control actions verified live and a human in the loop

cases.name: live-vscode-collaboration-session
cases.description: Set a breakpoint at the polluted result (main.py:21), run to it via the bridge and read second=36; then move to the root cause (tally.py:12) and read the shared mutable default. Requires DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE to point at an open+trusted VS Code folder holding the module; otherwise BLOCKED.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/vscode_bridge_session.py --wait-seconds 30

cases.name: fails-closed-without-live-bridge
cases.description: With a workspace that is not open in any VS Code window, the driver must fail closed -- report BRIDGE_BLOCKED and exit 3 -- rather than hang or fabricate a stop. This is the always-runnable half of the capability gate.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; WS="$(mktemp -d)"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/vscode_bridge_session.py --workspace "$WS" --wait-seconds 6
